tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: Hypothetical global meat demand if everyone in the world ate the same quantity as the average citizen of a given country.
For example, data for the US in 2020 shows global meat demand if everyone in the world consumed the same amount of
meat as the average US citizen in 2020. The curve for "World" gives the actual global meat production in 2020.

tspan.tspan: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025); Population based on various sources (2024)
This data reflects the amount of meat available for consumption, not actual intake. It does not account for food waste at the consumer
